story.text: The local working notebook for the Lattice Labs contribution — the [[Improbable Engine]], its geometry, and the path of its making. Work weaves here first, then travels to the shared research garden and its assets.

- [[Improbable Engine]] — the artwork and how to run it
- [[Six Strands]] — the fixed instrument: five labs and the hearth
- [[Lattice Torus Geometry]] — why the torus, the third seating
- [[Run Your Own Grid]] — for collaborators bringing their own farm
- [[Engine Chronicle]] — provenance of the build, guide-style
The wider research lives in the Lattice Garden — the alignment map, the weaving proposals, the lab pages — at the shared site and its mitch subwiki.
